# ByteSizedSecurity

> Cybersecurity insights and analysis — investigating cybercrime, security trends, vulnerabilities, and defense strategies.

## Author

Marc David, Staff Security Engineer, ISC2 CISSP
Credentials: https://www.credly.com/users/marcdavid
Site: https://blog.bytesizedsecurity.show
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/marccdavid

## About

ByteSizedSecurity is an independent cybersecurity blog covering threat intelligence, privacy, career guidance, and technical deep-dives for security professionals and enthusiasts. Published since 2024 with 80+ articles across 8 topic areas.

## Topic Taxonomy

- Network Security — privacy legislation, encryption policy, credential theft, insider threats
- Vulnerabilities — CVE analysis, data breaches, cloud misconfigurations
- DevSecOps — AI in security, career guidance, automation, future skills
- Web Security — browser extensions, malware delivery, Chrome zero-days
- Blue Team — incident response, identity protection, credit freezes, HIPAA compliance
- Pentesting — tools, ethical hacking, AI-assisted testing
- Cryptography — encryption, secure communications
- Reverse Engineering — malware analysis, binary internals

## Key Pages

- [About](https://blog.bytesizedsecurity.show/about/): Author bio, credentials, and mission
- [Cybersecurity Career Guide](https://blog.bytesizedsecurity.show/cybersecurity-career-guide/): Comprehensive career guide for breaking into cybersecurity — roles, certifications, networking, and job search strategy
- [Security Engineer Salary, Jobs & Career Path Explained](https://blog.bytesizedsecurity.show/security-engineer-salary-jobs-career-path/): Pillar guide to the security engineer role — salary by experience level (Indeed data, $64K-$218K), career path in from IT/sysadmin roles, required skills and certifications, and how to choose a network, cloud, or application security specialization
- [Why Employee Cybersecurity Training Fails: The 2026 Fix](https://blog.bytesizedsecurity.show/employee-cybersecurity-training-2026-fix/): CISSP-authored pillar for security leaders — why annual training does not change behavior, how to design a microtraining program on a spaced-repetition cadence, how to build an internal learning community with security champions, program metrics that actually move, and a concrete 90-day rollout plan for teams of 200 to 2,000 employees
- [2FA: The 5-Minute Fix That Stops 99% of Account Attacks](https://blog.bytesizedsecurity.show/2026/02/16/2fa-the-5-minute-fix-that-stops-99-percent-of-account-attacks/): Practical guide to two-factor authentication — which method to use, which accounts to protect first, and the Microsoft/Google research showing 99.9% attack reduction
- [LexisNexis & Credit Freezes: Your Guide to Identity Protection](https://blog.bytesizedsecurity.show/2026/02/26/lexisnexis-credit-freezes-your-guide-to-identity-protection/): Step-by-step guide to requesting your free LexisNexis Consumer Disclosure Report and freezing your credit at all three bureaus — including how to freeze your children's credit
- [Remove Personal Information From the Internet: 2026 Guide](https://blog.bytesizedsecurity.show/remove-personal-information-from-internet/): CISSP-authored evergreen guide to removing personal data from the internet — data broker opt-outs with a top-ten table, Google's Results About You tool, honest paid-service comparisons (DeleteMe, Incogni, EasyOptOuts, Privacy Bee, Kanary), CCPA and state privacy laws, and how to prevent your data from spreading again
- [Do Colleges Offer AI Degrees? Your 2026 Guide](https://blog.bytesizedsecurity.show/2026/07/06/do-colleges-offer-ai-degrees-2026-guide/): Comprehensive guide to U.S. colleges offering AI bachelor's degrees in 2026 — full program list, admission requirements, online options, and job outlook, including how to pair the degree with cybersecurity skills.
- [9 Best WeTransfer Alternatives in 2026 (Ranked by Privacy)](https://blog.bytesizedsecurity.show/2026/07/09/wetransfer-alternatives-2026-privacy-first/): Privacy-first comparison of nine WeTransfer alternatives, prompted by WeTransfer's 2024 acquisition, 75% staff cuts, and a since-reversed attempt to license user files for AI training.
- [Archive](https://blog.bytesizedsecurity.show/archive/): All posts organized by category
- [Podcast](https://bytesizedsecurity.show/): The ByteSizedSecurity podcast
